headline: Ahead on operations; in-line earnings

highlights: Per (%) 2/6/45 12M Avg Val (INR M) 1532 Financials & Valuations (INR b) Y/E March FY26 FY27E FY28E Sales 133.1 167.0 186.1 EBITDA 13.4 34.7 40.2 Adj.

Earnings were largely in line as the impact of higher-than-expected EBITDA was offset by lower other income.  On like-to-like basis, GNP outperformed industry in domestic formulation segment by almost 300bp for the quarter, backed by superior execution in cardiology, dermatology and respiratory segment.

It continued to launch differentiated oncology, respiratory as well as dermatology product, supporting better growth prospects in DF segment.  Excl. licensing income, GNP delivered healthy growth in North America (NA), largely led by product launches.
